constraints.name: ck_experiment_export_state
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'pending'::text) AND (completed_at IS NULL) AND (pdf_storage_key IS NULL) AND (pdf_sha256 IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'failed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (pdf_storage_key IS NULL) AND (pdf_sha256 IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'ready'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (pdf_storage_key IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(pdf_storage_key)) > 0) AND (pdf_sha256 IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: fk_export_item_revision
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (submission_id, revision_no) REFERENCES submission_revision(submission_id, revision_no)

constraints.name: ck_experiment_step_revision_has_submission
constraints.definition: CHECK (((pinned_revision_no IS NULL) OR (submission_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: fk_experiment_step_revision
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (submission_id, pinned_revision_no) REFERENCES submission_revision(submission_id, revision_no)

constraints.name: fk_experiment_step_submission_version
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (submission_id, template_version_id) REFERENCES submission(id, template_version_id)

constraints.name: ck_submission_project_reference
constraints.definition: CHECK (((project_reference IS NULL) OR (((char_length(project_reference) >= 1) AND (char_length(project_reference) <= 200)) AND (project_reference !~ '^[[:space:]]|[[:space:]]$'::text))))

constraints.name: ck_submission_sample_reference
constraints.definition: CHECK (((sample_reference IS NULL) OR (((char_length(sample_reference) >= 1) AND (char_length(sample_reference) <= 200)) AND (sample_reference !~ '^[[:space:]]|[[:space:]]$'::text))))

constraints.name: ck_submission_state
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'draft'::text) AND (current_revision_no IS NULL) AND (submitted_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'submitted'::text) AND (current_revision_no IS NOT NULL) AND (submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (project_reference IS NOT NULL) AND (sample_reference IS NOT NULL) AND (equipment_snapshot IS NOT NULL) AND (reference_snapshot IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: fk_submission_current_revision
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id, current_revision_no) REFERENCES submission_revision(submission_id, revision_no) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
